up: Return the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293286 (Polyadenylate-binding protein 1). Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293286'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
